assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NovaSeq 6000) of isolated pancreatic islets
samples: male C57BL/6 mice, 6-9 months old, n = 5 sedentary and n = 5 treadmill-trained (1 h/day, 10 days) (Fig. 2j,k legend; Fig. 4c,d legend)
inclusion: all 10 deposited samples; no exclusions stated
primary_estimand: effect of 10-day treadmill endurance training versus sedentary on islet gene expression in male C57BL/6 mice (causal, randomized intervention between independent animals)
planned_contrasts: trained vs sedentary (S1.3.p1, Fig. 2j,k; S1.5.p2, Fig. 4c,d; paper reports no DEG count)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S3.15.1.p1 (analysis done by Joslin core, no method or threshold); S3.23.p1 (P < 0.05 is for GraphPad physiology/qPCR statistics, not RNA-seq)

paper_method: not stated (Joslin Bioinformatics and Biostatistics Core; GEO data_processing: kallisto + tximport gene counts)
paper_results: gene-set level only: SenMayo senescence set reduced (violin + heatmap, Fig. 2j,k); glucagon signalling / GCGR-activation genes a top upregulated pathway (Fig. 4c,d, S1.5.p2). No DEG list or count in the text.
